method: The four active source plates were visually inspected and supplied to OpenAI image_gen as identity references. Four ten-pose sheets were generated in parallel. Each admitted PNG was copied byte-identically, without local cleanup, resizing, recoloring, compositing or pose synthesis. Python was used only for read-only PNG measurements and metadata; Chromium Canvas rendered diagnostic contact sheets without altering admitted pixels.

contract.layout: Five columns by two rows; variable transparent-gutter crop boundaries measured from each actual row.
contract.scale: One scale derived from neutral referenceHeight per identity; no per-pose stretching.
contract.feet: Each supported logical root is at its measured silhouette baseline. Contacts name actual alpha>=128 pixels within4pixels of that baseline.
contract.scope: Primary grounded J/K key poses; no special, super, complete gait or airborne attack claim.

fidelity.basis: Exact active project identities and inspected native plates, not primary franchise orthographic or motion references.
open: Complete locomotion, jumps and airborne primary attacks for these four identities remain undrawn.
Native ram specials and supers retain their own existing behavior and fallback visuals.
Franchise-exact body measurements, complete movesets and original motion cadence remain unverified.
Defender retains its qualified quadrupedal user adaptation; Xeno-Brute remains a noncanonical user-project identity.

historicalAssets: No earlier atlas or source plate was modified.

visualReview.method: Forty actual crop draws from four decoded real PNGs in Chromium154, fixed scale per identity, baseline and opaque-contact overlays.
visualReview.artifacts: Four identity contact sheets and their source measurements are kept in external evidence under reprise-v191/combat.
observed: All forty poses remain complete with no crop-edge silhouette loss.
Both step contacts and the three attack keys differ visibly; hit recoil and falling KO lower/rotate joints rather than using rigid rotation.
Final KO poses are sideways and low; Brute dorsal horns remain raised over its prone torso.
Tail tips, horns, foreclaws and feet remain within their actual PNG crops.
visualReview.limits: These are diagnostic compositions, not played matches or victories. Native runtime selection and full gameplay require the parent integration and QA.
